en.headline: Transwarp Technology opens flat at HK$49 on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: The AI infrastructure software firm priced at the bottom of its range after the public offer was more than 70 times subscribed, raising about HK$686 million.
body: Shares in Transwarp Technology, stock code 06727, opened at HK$49 when they began trading on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Monday morning, matching the final offer price.

The company, which describes itself as an artificial-intelligence infrastructure software provider, priced the listing at the bottom of a HK$49 to HK$61 range. It raised about HK$686 million. Haitong International was the sole sponsor.

The Hong Kong public offer drew applications from about 20,000 people and was more than 70 times subscribed. About 10 per cent of applicants for a single board lot of 100 shares received an allocation. The international tranche was 0.42 times subscribed. Grey-market trading on Sunday closed at HK$48.36, about 1.3 per cent below the issue price.
Trading opened at 9am. Early quotes after the open stayed close to the issue price.

zh.headline: 星環科技首掛平開報49元
zh.dek: 這家人工智能基礎設施軟件公司以招股價下限定價，公開發售超購逾70倍，集資約6.86億元。
body: 星環科技（股份代號06727）周一早上在港交所掛牌，開市報49元，與最終發售價相同。
公司為人工智能基礎設施軟件供應商，招股價介乎49元至61元，最終以下限定價，集資約6.86億元。獨家保薦人為海通國際。
香港公開發售約有2萬人申請，超額認購逾70倍。認購一手100股的申請人中，約一成獲配股份。國際發售超額認購0.42倍。週日輝立暗盤收報48.36元，較定價低約1.3%。
股份上午9時開始買賣，開市後早段報價貼近發行價。
